newsitem.title: ITALY: New collapsable containers ease airfreight industry.
newsitem.headline: New collapsable containers ease airfreight industry.

text.p: European Aviation Products of Monsano said it has patented a system to produce collapsable ULD (united load device) air containers.
The new system has been patented in Italy Europe and the U.S. and has the advantage of utilising space for empty transportation -- eight collapsed containers take up the space of one open container.
Structually the container, made of anitcorrosive aluminium, is stronger than normal ULD's and is easier and less expensive to maintain.
In addition, it permits handlers to avoid the "sail effect" that is often a problem at airports for empty containers stored outside.

"The container was designed to transport hanging garments, but it can also be utilised to transport fabric, leather goods, shoes and packaged foodstuffs. An added advantage is that it eliminates the need for cardboard or wooden packaging. It can be sealed at the factory eliminating pilferage," said Paolo Coppi, president and member of the Board of directors of European Aviation Products. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
